task.summary: Fix long-option parsing so that a long option followed by a standalone dash (for example `--foo -`) takes the dash as its value, consistent with the existing short-option behavior, instead of leaving the dash as a positional argument. Preserve existing parsing behavior for other dash-prefixed values.
